failure_reason: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF/DataDome/CAPTCHA on any real content page). A path-class anti-scan trigger began redirecting /shop/* requests to /blocked?url=... partway through investigation - it hit AFTER the three rows below were already captured cleanly, but before I could probe equivalent per-department New Arrivals URLs for Bath, Bedding, Kitchen & Dining, Patio & Garden, Appliances, Mattresses, Luggage, or Kids' Rooms. Those hub pages were checked for a dept-specific New Arrivals hubspoke/nav link (Bath, Bedding, Kitchen & Dining, Patio & Garden all came back with only irrelevant shared-header Clothing/Toys 'new-arrivals' links, no Home-relevant one), which is reasonable but not fully proven absence given the block cut off direct URL confirmation.
notes: SCOPE: Home dept (cat_id 4044) + Furniture + Patio & Garden (5428) + Home Decor (see bs194.json for full scope reasoning). URL-PATTERN OBSERVATION: Walmart exposes New Arrivals at the sub-department level with an inconsistent URL shape per department (/shop/home-decor-new-arrivals for Decor, /shop/home/furniture-new-arrivals for Furniture, /shop/home/storage-new-arrivals for Storage) rather than one unified 'Home New Arrivals' hub - a direct guess at /shop/home/new-arrivals and /shop/all-home/new-arrivals both resolved to the site's own /blocked anti-scan page (not a genuine 404), so no unified parent page could be confirmed to exist or not exist; treated as absent-until-proven and not forced into the output. COLLECTION-PAGE CHECK: all three kept rows were opened and confirmed to be genuine PLPs (product grid with sort/filter, an exact or capped product count in the page's own JSON state), not editorial/lookbook pages - none required an AMBIGUOUS flag. COUNT METHODOLOGY: 'Home Decor New Arrivals' shows an uncapped exact totalItemCountDisplay '(279)' - kept as exact per this company's established convention (uncapped display = trustworthy). 'New Furniture' (2,022) and 'New Storage' (1,949) both show the capped '(1000+)' display, which per this company's prior-pass finding is not exhaustion-checkable and has proven internally inconsistent elsewhere on this site at scale - so both are set to null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than reporting the raw capped-display JSON numbers as fact. Décor hub's 'Currently Trending' module also surfaced several theme/style pages (Dorm Decor, Farmhouse Decor, Boho Decor, Coastal Decor, Arch Mirrors, Tech-Enabled Decor, Botanical Wall Art, LED Mirrors) - these are style/theme category pages, not 'recently added to catalogue' New Arrivals listings, and were excluded (they belong to the separate Home-Decor category-extraction project, not here). No 'New & Trending' page for Furniture could be verified (URL contains a literal '&' that resolved to /blocked on every attempt, both before and after the rate-limit trigger) - excluded as unverifiable rather than guessed.
